International Service for Human Rights (ISHR) / yleisrahoitus

description.narrative:
Hanke tukee ISHR:n strategista suunnitelmaa vuosille 2021-2025, joka tukee Suomen tavoitteita ihmisoikeuspuolustajien tukemiseksi maailmalla. Tavoite 1: Ihmisoikeuspuolustajat ovat varusteltuja, verkostuneita, tuettuja ja vaikuttavia
Tavoite 2: Toimitaan valtioiden, yritysten ja muiden valtiosta riippumattomien toimijoiden kanssa ihmisoikeuspuolustajien kunnioittamiseksi ja suojelemiseksi
Tavoite 3: Varmistetaan, että ihmisoikeuslait ja -mekanismit ovat ihmisoikeuspuolustajien saatavilla, responsiivisiä ja tehokkaita

ISHR seeks to pursue the objectives of our institutional strategy 2021-25 which strongly align with Finland’s objectives on the global protection of HRDs. Goal 1: Ensure that Human Rights Defenders (HRDs) are equipped, connected, supported and influential 1.1. HRDs have the tools and capacities (including strategies, networks, knowledge and narratives) to engage and influence international, regional and national mechanisms and actors, online and offline, and, through them, to contribute to the promotion, protection and realisation of human rights at all levels 1.2. HRDs are supported and provided with solidarity by collaborative and intersectional networks and coalitions 1.3. HRDs deprived of liberty, subject to reprisals or other grave violations are able to seek justice and accountability through international and regional human rights bodies and to leverage the voices of civil society, States, and international and regional mechanisms to take action when their rights are restricted ? Goal 2: Engage with States, businesses and other non-State actors to respect and protect human rights defenders 2.1. States stop or refrain from restricting, hindering or criminalising HRDs and their work, including by repealing or amending restrictive legislation 2.2. States consult with and become positive advocates for human rights defenders and take legislative and policy action to respect and protect human rights defenders at the national, regional and international levels. 2.3. States and international and regional mechanisms hold other States that restrict, hinder or criminalise human rights defenders and their work accountable. 2.4. Businesses and other non-State actors are effectively regulated with respect to human rights and HRDs, consult with and become positive advocates for HRDs, take action to respect and contribute to the protection of HRDs, refrain from actions that restrict or violate their rights, and are held accountable when they fail to do so ? Goal 3: Ensure that human rights laws and mechanisms are accessible, responsive and effective for human rights defenders 3.1 There is renewed and strengthened support, including through adequate funding and effective narratives, across all regions for multilateralism and an international order founded on respect for human rights, justice and the rule of law ...
